name: kattakath
description: Ismail Kattakath's agent skills and Claude Code plugins: an answer-shape kit, hook supervision, Nix-flake hooks, userscript authoring with live-page diagnosis, llms.txt authoring, a repo foundation audit, macOS app automation, and standalone skills for local RAG, Android over ADB, Nix dev toolkits, capability discovery, skill harvesting and curation, discovery write-ups, JSON Resume tailoring and GitHub release gating.

plugins.name: android-phone
plugins.description: Connect and operate a physical Android device over ADB, wired or wireless: pairing, connecting, TCP/IP bootstrap and scrcpy mirroring.

plugins.name: apify
plugins.description: Apify Store Actors as tools — web scraping, crawling and extraction, including the rag-web-browser and web-fetch lane. Runs locally against an API token read from the macOS login Keychain by a Nix-installed launcher, not through a hosted OAuth bridge.

plugins.name: brag-dossier
plugins.description: Turn a session's discovery into one organized, fact-checked source document: a BRIEF from the vague intent, a FACTS sheet from the records, then parallel section writers, adversarial fact-check, assembly and a completeness critic. Built for agents to derive posts, articles and slides from.

plugins.name: brain-signals
plugins.description: An answer-shape kit for scannable, verdict-first answers: the Brain Signals output style, the /explain family (explain, compare, map, zoom, why, tldr, diagram), a read-only cartographer subagent for architecture maps, and /task for goal-locked execution.

plugins.name: capability-broker
plugins.description: When a goal needs a capability the session lacks: take stock of what is installed, find and vet candidates (MCP servers, skills, plugins, tools), and adopt the least powerful one that works.

plugins.name: claude-code-nix
plugins.description: Hooks for working on Nix flakes with Claude Code: auto-stage .nix writes so flake evaluation sees them, and flag hardcoded per-user home paths in .nix values.

plugins.name: empire
plugins.description: Bring an unflaked repo up to a verified standard in an isolated worktree, implement inside one repo with memory that survives the session, and research a decision across parallel read-only lanes with a deterministic Senate workflow.

plugins.name: foundation-audit
plugins.description: Four-dimension foundation audit of a config monorepo — architecture and the boundary violations structural gates structurally cannot see, duplication judged by purpose, activation failure modes classified by how they fail, and dead surface including guardrails that match nothing. Fans out four lane-scoped agents in parallel, each returning findings, a CONFIRMED-SOUND list and mandatory UNKNOWNS; the orchestrator re-verifies the top findings itself before relaying.

plugins.name: github-release-gate
plugins.description: Make a GitHub repo's default branch a safe release: require the CI check with a ruleset, then allow auto-merge and arm it on same-repo PRs only (forks wait), verifying each step against GitHub. Covers the admin-token limits and the gh --auto immediate-merge footgun.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Four Gmail accounts as separate per-session MCP servers, each launched by a Nix-installed wrapper that reads the OAuth client credentials from the macOS login Keychain so nothing secret lives in this repo.

plugins.name: harvest
plugins.description: At the end of a task worth repeating: pick the right artifact type (skill, agent, workflow), strip anything machine- or secret-specific, and write it in the standard format.

plugins.name: jsonresume-tailor
plugins.description: Tailor a JSON Resume (resume.json) to a specific job posting without fabricating anything, then validate it and render a PDF.

plugins.name: llmstxt
plugins.description: Author spec-compliant llms.txt (and the de-facto llms-full.txt) from any body of written work — docs, a site, a repo, or a developer accomplishment document.

plugins.name: logo-construction-geometry
plugins.description: Rebuild a raster or noisy auto-traced logo as clean SVG from measured construction geometry: find centres, radii, angles and nodes, infer the rule, regenerate from named parameters, score the overlap against the source.

plugins.name: mac-app-send
plugins.description: Drive a native macOS app with the computer-use MCP to send a formatted message and attach files. Ships the method skill, a preflight doctor that resolves bundle id and running state in one shot, a file manifest that gives the exact bytes/KB/page counts a send is verified against, and a PreToolUse guard blocking the three moves that cannot work: an osascript workaround at the Open/Save panel, a multi-line app_type without element_index, and request_access on the panel service.

plugins.name: mcp-utilities
plugins.description: The four keyless, domain-free MCP servers the retired fleet gateway carried: a persistent knowledge graph, a sequential-reasoning scaffold, Terraform registry lookup, and cross-registry MCP server discovery. No credentials, no account, nothing to configure.

plugins.name: nix-dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Make a repo self-contained with a Nix flake for development, deployment and maintenance: dev shells, local Postgres with pgvector, self-hosted runners, and an env-var catalogue.

plugins.name: page-lab
plugins.description: Author Violentmonkey userscripts and diagnose live pages from one place — a measure-before-you-select method, a two-way element picker driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, a config-driven redesign acceptance runner that injects at document-start across real navigations and exercises the result with trusted events, performance/network/console diagnosis, and a Greasy Fork readiness linter, and a multi-agent method for redesigning a whole site.

plugins.name: prior-art-recon
plugins.description: Before building, standardising or publishing anything meant to fill a perceived gap: find out whether it already exists, whether anyone wants it, whether the ecosystem is moving away from it, and whether the gap is an artifact of your own design.

plugins.name: rag
plugins.description: Retrieval-augmented generation over a local pgvector store: ingest documents, then answer questions from that corpus. Runs locally with in-database embeddings.

plugins.name: session-relay
plugins.description: Work that crosses between concurrent Claude sessions: find this session's own address, hand out a paste-ready calling card, read which peers are actually reachable, and handle an inbound peer message without laundering a permission decision.

plugins.name: silent-instruments
plugins.description: The instrument layer under a verification gate: a measured catalogue of commands that exit 0 having measured nothing — a stale PIPESTATUS, a CI run green because its only job skipped, ancestry after a squash, a truncated API page, a zsh loop that iterates once — plus a PostToolUse advisory that names the cross-check. No linter covers these; ShellCheck catches none of them and refuses zsh outright.

plugins.name: skill-curator
plugins.description: Keep a skill library from only growing: count real usage from Claude Code transcripts, mark skills stale or archive-candidate (pinned and depended-on skills exempt), and propose retirements and merges as a reviewable PR. Ported from the Hermes Agent curator.

plugins.name: superhook
plugins.description: Supervising dispatcher for command-type Claude Code hooks: crash safety so a throwing hook can never wedge a session, and a 3-strikes loop breaker so a mis-firing gate cannot trap an agent forever.

plugins.name: wordpress
plugins.description: WordPress site administration over the REST API — posts, pages, media, taxonomies, comments, users and SEO — against a PRODUCTION site. Credentials come from the macOS login Keychain via a Nix-installed launcher, never from this repo.

plugins.name: desktop-commander
plugins.description: Shell and filesystem tools that run OUTSIDE Claude Code's Bash tool — the escape hatch for a worktree-isolated session whose worktree was deleted and which therefore refuses every Bash call. Confined by a macOS Seatbelt profile from a Nix-installed launcher, not by the server's own allowedDirectories, which its own documentation disclaims as a boundary. Ships a PreToolUse guard that blocks the command-text denies a filesystem sandbox structurally cannot express — printing a secret, decrypting an age file, a force-push, merging a PR — and points back at Bash whenever Bash works, plus a skill for actually working a locked session.
